page_note: Page contains the close of one chapter (segs 0-16: Mani's first-person hortatory address about his elect being like sun-rays, gathering at his coming forth), followed by Chapter 68 'Concerning the Fire' with a clean five-fold enumeration of the works of fire (substrate teaching), and the opening of Chapter 69 'Concerning the Twelve Zodiac-signs and Five Stars' which breaks off in the dialogue frame formula. The Fire teaching is pure substrate: fire releases/burns wood; separates four likenesses (fire, light, smoke, vapor); gives taste/savor/salt/sweetness; enables artisans to mold vessels; manifests light. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The first half of the page (Mani gathering his elect) is hortatory-ecclesial application material.
